summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests belantamab mafodotin combined with carfilzomib, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone (KPd) in adults with relapsed multiple myeloma. Belantamab mafodotin is given by IV on Day 1 of 28-day cycles, and the other drugs follow the schedules listed in the record; participation is about 6 to 24 months. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa belantamab mafodotina combinada con carfilzomib, pomalidomida y dexametasona (KPd) en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante. La belantamab mafodotina se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de ciclos de 28 días, y los otros medicamentos siguen los esquemas indicados en el registro; la participación dura aproximadamente de 6 a 24 meses. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma that has progressed after at least 2 prior lines of anti-myeloma treatment
Measurable disease by serum M-protein, urine M-protein, or involved free light chains
ECOG performance status of 2 or less and life expectancy over 3 months
Cohort 2 includes participants who had prior CAR T-cell therapy
not_for: Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, systemic amyloidosis, POEMS syndrome, or plasma cell leukemia at screening
Prior refractory status to belantamab mafodotin
Significant neuropathy (Grade 3-4, or Grade 2 with pain)
Active infection requiring treatment, or serious cardiovascular risk such as uncontrolled arrhythmia or uncontrolled hypertension
